import numpy as np

def choose_next_customer(
    current_position: np.ndarray,
    depot_position: np.ndarray,
    truck_positions: np.ndarray,
    available_customers: np.ndarray,
    current_time: float,
) -> int | None:
    if len(available_customers) == 0:
        return None
    
    cur_to_cust = np.linalg.norm(available_customers - current_position, axis=1)
    cust_to_depot = np.linalg.norm(available_customers - depot_position, axis=1)
    cost_now = cur_to_cust + cust_to_depot
    
    mask = ~np.all(np.abs(truck_positions - current_position) < 1e-8, axis=1)
    other_trucks = truck_positions[mask]
    
    if len(other_trucks) == 0:
        return int(np.argmin(cost_now))
    
    other_to_cust = np.linalg.norm(available_customers[:, None, :] - other_trucks[None, :, :], axis=2)
    best_other_cost = np.min(other_to_cust, axis=1) + cust_to_depot
    regret = best_other_cost - cost_now
    
    centroid_other = np.mean(other_trucks, axis=0)
    dist_to_centroid = np.linalg.norm(available_customers - centroid_other, axis=1)
    alpha = 0.3
    regret += alpha * dist_to_centroid
    
    current_depot_dist = np.linalg.norm(current_position - depot_position)
    other_depot_dists = np.linalg.norm(other_trucks - depot_position, axis=1)
    current_max_depot = max(current_depot_dist, np.max(other_depot_dists))
    new_max = np.maximum(np.max(other_depot_dists), cust_to_depot)
    reduction = current_max_depot - new_max
    beta = 0.2
    regret += beta * reduction
    
    max_regret = np.max(regret)
    if max_regret > 1e-6:
        best_idx = np.argmax(regret)
        return int(best_idx)
    
    is_farthest = current_depot_dist >= np.max(other_depot_dists) - 1e-6
    n_trucks = len(truck_positions)
    wait_threshold = max(5, n_trucks)
    if is_farthest or len(available_customers) <= wait_threshold:
        best_idx = np.argmin(cost_now)
        return int(best_idx)
    else:
        return None

import numpy as np

def choose_next_customer(
    current_position: np.ndarray,
    depot_position: np.ndarray,
    truck_positions: np.ndarray,
    available_customers: np.ndarray,
    current_time: float,
) -> int | None:
    if len(available_customers) == 0:
        return None
    
    # distances
    cur_to_cust = np.linalg.norm(available_customers - current_position, axis=1)
    cust_to_depot = np.linalg.norm(available_customers - depot_position, axis=1)
    own_score = cur_to_cust + cust_to_depot
    
    # other trucks
    mask = ~np.all(truck_positions == current_position, axis=1)
    other_trucks = truck_positions[mask]
    if len(other_trucks) == 0:
        return int(np.argmin(own_score))
    
    # distance from each customer to nearest other truck
    dist_to_other = np.linalg.norm(available_customers[:, None] - other_trucks[None, :], axis=2)
    nearest_other = np.min(dist_to_other, axis=1)
    
    # fleet balance: distance from customer to centroid of other trucks
    centroid_other = np.mean(other_trucks, axis=0)
    dist_to_centroid = np.linalg.norm(available_customers - centroid_other, axis=1)
    
    # time-dependent parameters
    t = current_time
    beta = 2.0 * max(0, 1 - 0.12 * t)  # faster decay
    gamma = 2.0 * max(0, 1 - 0.1 * t)
    alpha = 0.4  # fleet balance weight
    
    # score = cur_to_cust - beta*nearest_other + (1-gamma)*cust_to_depot - alpha*dist_to_centroid
    score = cur_to_cust + cust_to_depot - beta * nearest_other - gamma * cust_to_depot - alpha * dist_to_centroid
    
    # tie-breaking: prefer smaller cust_to_depot if scores very close
    best_idx = np.argmin(score)
    best_score = score[best_idx]
    eps = 1e-6
    candidates = np.where(score - best_score < eps)[0]
    if len(candidates) > 1:
        best_idx = candidates[np.argmin(cust_to_depot[candidates])]
    
    # waiting condition: stricter
    cur_to_depot = np.linalg.norm(current_position - depot_position)
    mean_other_depot = np.mean(np.linalg.norm(other_trucks - depot_position, axis=1))
    min_own = np.min(own_score)
    if cur_to_depot < 0.2 * mean_other_depot and min_own > 4 * cur_to_depot and len(available_customers) <= 3:
        return None
    
    return int(best_idx)

    other_trucks = truck_positions[~mask]

    regret = best_other_cost - cost_now  # positive means urgent

    if max_regret > 1e-6:
        best_idx = np.argmax(regret)
        return int(best_idx)
    
    # No positive regret
    current_depot_dist = np.linalg.norm(current_position - depot_position)

    is_farthest = current_depot_dist >= max_other_depot - 1e-6
    
    if is_farthest:
        # farthest truck should not wait
        best_idx = np.argmin(cost_now)
        return int(best_idx)
    else:
        min_cost = np.min(cost_now)
        if min_cost < current_depot_dist:

            best_idx = np.argmin(cost_now)
            return int(best_idx)
        elif len(available_customers) > 2:
            # wait (other trucks are better positioned)
            return None
        else:
            # few customers left, serve to avoid idle
            best_idx = np.argmin(cost_now)
            return int(best_idx)

import numpy as np

def choose_next_customer(
    current_position: np.ndarray,
    depot_position: np.ndarray,
    truck_positions: np.ndarray,
    available_customers: np.ndarray,
    current_time: float,
) -> int | None:
    if len(available_customers) == 0:
        return None
    
    # Costs for current truck
    cur_to_cust = np.linalg.norm(available_customers - current_position, axis=1)
    cust_to_depot = np.linalg.norm(available_customers - depot_position, axis=1)
    cost_now = cur_to_cust + cust_to_depot
    
    # Other trucks mask
    mask = ~np.all(np.abs(truck_positions - current_position) < 1e-8, axis=1)
    other_trucks = truck_positions[mask]
    
    if len(other_trucks) == 0:
        return int(np.argmin(cost_now))
    
    # Regret: best other cost - cost_now
    other_to_cust = np.linalg.norm(available_customers[:, None, :] - other_trucks[None, :, :], axis=2)
    best_other_cost = np.min(other_to_cust, axis=1) + cust_to_depot
    regret = best_other_cost - cost_now
    
    # Fleet balance bonus: positive for customers far from centroid of other trucks
    centroid_other = np.mean(other_trucks, axis=0)
    dist_to_centroid = np.linalg.norm(available_customers - centroid_other, axis=1)
    alpha = 0.2
    regret += alpha * dist_to_centroid
    
    # Bonus for reducing the maximum depot distance
    current_depot_dist = np.linalg.norm(current_position - depot_position)
    other_depot_dists = np.linalg.norm(other_trucks - depot_position, axis=1)
    current_max_depot = max(current_depot_dist, np.max(other_depot_dists))
    new_max = np.maximum(np.max(other_depot_dists), cust_to_depot)
    reduction = current_max_depot - new_max
    beta = 0.1
    regret += beta * reduction
    
    max_regret = np.max(regret)
    if max_regret > 1e-6:
        best_idx = np.argmax(regret)
        return int(best_idx)
    
    # No positive regret: decide whether to wait
    is_farthest = current_depot_dist >= np.max(other_depot_dists) - 1e-6
    if is_farthest or len(available_customers) <= 2:
        best_idx = np.argmin(cost_now)
        return int(best_idx)
    else:
        return None
